_readme: Danish electricity tax used by the cost model (kr/kWh excl. VAT) and the elvarme allowance. Edit this file when a new rate is published (skat.dk); no code change or deploy of PHP is needed. A rate applies from its 'from' date until the next row, so history is priced at the rate of its time. Add next year's row before 1 January: dev/test_config_rates.php fails from then if it is missing.
